invariants.rationale: An Array is allocated and returned in all execution paths that do not throw.
tmxFile is always used to parse XML, so it cannot be null in any successful execution.
fileName is used in exception construction, so it cannot be null if the point is reached.
parameter is not dereferenced anywhere, so can be null or non-null; this is not tautological as it documents the param's non-use.
A newly created Array always has non-negative size, potentially zero if there are no tile sheets.
